title: Newton's Bubble

beats.text: Isaac Newton, one of history's greatest minds, got burned by a stock bubble.
In early seventeen twenty, South Sea Company shares were soaring.
Newton sold his shares and doubled his money.
But the price kept climbing, past a thousand pounds a share.
So he jumped back in, near the very top.
By September, the shares had collapsed below two hundred.
The man who explained gravity lost a fortune.
Legend says he grumbled he could calculate the heavens,
but not the madness of people.

caption:
Isaac Newton sold his South Sea Company shares early in 1720 and doubled his money. Then he bought back in near the top, and the bubble burst.

Even a genius needs temperament more than brilliance.
